source: the image documents -Xmx in JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS as the way to change its heap cap; the heap-derived defaults (maxEventLogSizeInBytes, maxOpenAiResponsesSizeInBytes, maxLogEntries, maxPendingDelayedResponses, maxQueuedTemplateActions; maxExpectations stays at its cap), in GET /mockserver/config and GET /mockserver/configuration alike follow a 512 MiB ceiling less 20 MiB instead of 45% of the container memory.
